title: docs(plugin-auth): rewrite the sys_member valid_from exclusion note for the post-#10982 window-filtered projection
body:
Fixes #11089

## What this is

A comment-only correction in the security-adjacent exclusion ledger of `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/last-admin-guard.ts`, re-verified against the merged ref (base `d39569239b`) per the triage instruction, plus the one matrix clause that pinned the stale prose.

The `valid_from` / `valid_until` entry under `sys_member` in `STANDING_KEY_EXCLUSIONS` said the org-administration role projection is "NOT window filtered". That was true when written and has been false since #10982 landed member-role window filtering.

## Re-verification (the task itself)

Established from the merged code on this branch's base, not from the card's description:

- `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts:430-436` — the role projection now drops membership rows through `isGrantActive(m, nowMs)` BEFORE the derivation ("Rows outside their validity window are dropped BEFORE the role derivation ... Maintainer ruling 2026-08-22 (live session, item 2): a lapsed membership is NO MEMBERSHIP").
- `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts:409` — `accessible_org_ids` applies the same predicate (this half was already filtered before #10982).
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/last-admin-guard.ts:836` — the guard still counts org administrators by grade alone (`if (!isOrgAdminGrade(m.role)) continue;`), unchanged.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-member.object.ts` fields block — `sys_member` still declares no `valid_from`/`valid_until` columns; `AUTH_MEMBER_SCHEMA` (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-schema-config.ts:207-214`) maps none.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts:1199` — `undeclaredWriteFieldErrors` (callers on both insert and update, the "declared-field door") refuses an undeclared write key, so no write can smuggle a bound onto a membership row today.

So the card's premise holds exactly as filed: the exclusion decision is right, the note's middle step described an unfiltered read that no longer exists, and its closing "reconcile in the resolver first" instruction was discharged by #10982.

## The rewrite

The note (guard file, line 665) now states: the columns still do not exist and the engine refuses undeclared write keys — why the exclusion is still safe today; both derivations off the one `sys_member` read apply `isGrantActive` since #10982 (maintainer ruling 2026-08-22: a lapsed membership is NO membership); the guard still counts by grade alone; and the forward-looking instruction is inverted — the day the columns land, these four spellings must move into `MEMBER_STANDING_KEYS` and the member count must adopt the same predicate, because a `valid_until` write then becomes a revocation shape a grade-only count cannot see.

## Files touched

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/last-admin-guard.ts` — the note. The card's carrier.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-conformance.matrix.ts` — one clause of the grant-validity row's `note` string. This is the declared carrier's "test that pins the note": the clause (written in PR #11088) recorded that the guard notes "still describe the role projection as unfiltered" — a statement made false by this PR, i.e. the exact stale-explanation-beside-a-flipped-assertion shape this card is a specimen of, one generation later. No test in the repo reads the matrix `note` field (grep for `.note` across dogfood tests: zero hits), so that change is prose-only too.

## Changeset

None, deliberately: this PR releases nothing (comment-only diff; per AGENTS.md, feature work needs a changeset and pure fixes do not — a fortiori prose). It takes the `skip-changeset` label per the changeset-check workflow's own route-2 prescription.

Clause-②: no — no accept/reject behaviour changes, no public surface widens.

## Verification (all on `d4617137a0`, the final commit, after it was committed)

- No ablation: a comment-only diff has no behaviour to ablate — stated per the dispatch instruction rather than performed as ritual.
- `@objectstack/plugin-auth` build + full test suite: "Test Files  70 passed (70)" / "Tests  1455 passed (1455)".
- `@objectstack/dogfood` full suite: "Test Files  125 passed | 1 skipped (126)" / "Tests  905 passed | 3 skipped (908)". (The intended single-file run widened to the whole suite: pnpm forwarded a literal `--` ahead of the vitest args, so the file filter was ignored — the result is a superset of the intended evidence. The one skipped file is the organizations `skipIf`, not `authz-conformance.test.ts`, which carries no skip construct.)
- typecheck: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` and `@objectstack/dogfood`, both green (script echo lines confirmed both ran; verify-lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- Gate union from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (no hand-supplied paths; derivation stamped "tree of 'objectstack-ai/objectstack' at commit d4617137a0"): 11 families matched, each run to its own verdict, all exit 0 — e.g. `check:published-files` ("69 publishable package(s) ... declare a `files` whitelist"), `check:test-source-alias` OK, `check:slot-lookup` ("ratchet holds ... none new"), `check:liveness` ("state-counts.md is current"), affected-docs ("self-test: 339 cases pass").
- `pnpm check:nul-bytes`: "OK (scanned 6376 text file(s) ... no raw ASCII control bytes)".

For the record: #10982 is referenced, not re-adjudicated; the guard file's other ADR-0091 window mentions concern the grant table and were verified accurate as they stand.
